units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 3:3">Tosef. Succ. III, 3</cite> [read:] <he>ר׳ אליעזר אומר והנה מים מפכים מלמד שמים מְפַכְפְּכִין ועולין כמין פי הפך וכ׳</he> R. El. … says, ‘And behold waters dripping’ (<cite ref="Ezekiel 47:2">Ez. XLVII, 2</cite>), this intimates that in the days to come water oozing out and rising, as if coming out of a flask, will come forth from under the threshold &c., v. <cite ref="Q00910"><he>פָּכָה</he></cite>. Ib. 11 <he>כך היתה הבאר … מְפַכְפֶּכֶת ועולה וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>מפרפר</he>) so the well that travelled with Israel in the desert, resembling a rock of the size of a k’barah (<cite ref="K00077"><he>כְּבָרָה</he></cite>), bubbled forth and rose, travelling with them up mountains and down &c.
